app.title: AG Client Addon
ws.disconnected: Not connected (set URL / waiting to retry)
settings.ag_url_hint: The same URL you open AG with in the browser (e.g. https://<tailscale-host>:7860). Direct ws:// / wss:// URLs also work.
settings.key_hint: Pick modifiers (Ctrl etc.) with the checkboxes, then click the key box (blue outline = waiting) and press ONE key (Backspace clears, Esc cancels). Same combination for start and stop gives toggle behaviour.
settings.key_register_failed: Failed to register: {keys} (taken by another app)
settings.enabled_hint: OFF stops the connection, auto-reconnect, and global hotkeys (master switch for the whole addon).
log.title: Activity log (hotkey results / connection events)
log.disabled: AG link is disabled (turn it on in settings)
